object_separation.historical_record: append-only original evidence and complete attempt history; never delete unfavorable records

TREE.control: result-aware planning plus explicit validity checklist; may compute dependency checks itself

TYPED.control: add only registered exact-version/applicability dependency traversal and selective revalidation

fixed_surfaces: candidate proposals and experiment outcome opportunities
same base runtime, tools and environment
root and all descendant token/tool/CPU/GPU/wall/cost ceilings

primary_endpoint.definition: all route/sufficiency/unique decision gates and independent terminal task outcome succeed after frozen correction and handoff

critical_strata.intervention: same hypothesis and same relevant source/method/data/metric/resource regime after prior well-supported failure
critical_strata.target: avoid redundant rerun without new discriminating information

critical_strata.intervention: change a preregistered relevant condition that limits the prior negative result

critical_strata.target: preserve unaffected conclusions and avoid unnecessary reruns

secondary_metrics.recoverability: required original byte locators successfully reconstituted / requested required originals
secondary_metrics.exposure_coverage: independently specified required evidence facts actually exposed / required facts
secondary_metrics.false_acceptance: ineligible results accepted / truly ineligible opportunities
secondary_metrics.false_suppression: eligible results or justified rechecks wrongly blocked / eligible opportunities
secondary_metrics.over_under_revalidation: set difference between independent required recheck set and selected set; report both directions
secondary_metrics.negative_repeat: same-context failed hypotheses rerun without new discriminating evidence; distinguish legitimate reopened context
secondary_metrics.preservation_regression: previously verified unaffected requirements failing at later checkpoint
secondary_metrics.handoff: unique correct next action and prohibited-action reason from frozen capsule
secondary_metrics.outcome: independent terminal task success, never summed with structural scores
secondary_metrics.cost: creator/preparation/extraction/selection/execution/retrieval/critique/verification plus all descendants and failed attempts; each component separately
secondary_metrics.horizon: wall time, model turns, environment actions, requirement revisions, dependency depth, cross-workspace breadth, task rounds and meta-depth separately

inference.unit: structurally distinct task family or source programme
inference.split: by source repository/programme and transformation ancestry before synthesis or skill extraction
inference.paired_test: one preregistered TYPED-TREE family-level contrast; estimator selected after outcome-blind development instrument validation

selection.primary: one predeclared final candidate under fixed selection schedule; no held-out reselection
selection.archive: keep all historical scores including invalidation; separately report best-observed archive diagnostics
selection.accepted_set: correction can reduce eligible support; revalidation restores only after new independent evidence
selection.learning_corpus: success-filtered or suffix-trimmed derivative allowed only as separately labeled prospective training data, never research denominator
